text.p: Shares of the initial public offering of Tel Aviv-based Orckit Communications Ltd soared 4-1/4 to 20-1/4 on Friday.
The telecom products company priced 3.3 million shares at $16 per share, with Alex. Brown as the lead underwriter.
Orckit designs digital subscriber line systems that allow telephone companies to provide high-speed, digital transmission of information over the last miles of the existing telephone network.

Since the explosion of growth of Internet use, phone companies are under pressure to meet this demand. The last transmission miles are often slower because the traditional copper wires offer less speed.

Orckit posted a loss in 1994 and 1995, and has said it expects to incur further losses and doesn't anticipate significant commercial shipments of its ADSL and Internet products at least through 1997. Four of its largest customers accounted for about 72 percent of its 1995 product revenues.
Principal competitors include Amati Communications Corp, Aware Inc, Lucent Technologies Inc, and Alcatel Network Systems Inc, a unit of Alcatel Alsthom Cie Generale d'Electricite'.
